tg_station_lead: Everything on this floor is public. Ask for a figure and you will get the figure.
The floor below is survey, and survey has never been public anywhere.
I have worked here eleven years and I have been down it four times.
tg_station_sci: I run the storm glasses. In spring I called a squall six hours out and the fleet came in.
Nine boats. Nine crews. That is what this building is for.
When somebody tells you what we are, start with the nine.
tg_station_sci_f: The equipment coming down the ridge road is not ours. Not this station.
It comes through us and goes onto the water and none of it is logged here.
I asked. I was told it was a different directorate. There is no different directorate.
tg_station_hand: Best job I have ever had. Warm building, fair pay, and the work is good work.
Whatever anybody tells you outside, most of us are exactly what it says on the door.
